attr.title: Rally Championship
attr.desc: Rally Championship Remaster: a reimplementation of the 1999 PC rally game Mobil 1 Rally Championship by Magnetic Fields, with the original's handling, physics, damage and race rules.
attr.inst: Requires your own copy of the original PC game. Copy RAL.EXE and the files and var folders from your installation into ports/rallychampionship/game/.
